selection.pool_rule: CARLA test scans with >= 3 GT cars at 20-50 m; seeded random sample of 2000 of 24800
selection.matching: GeoPillarsMetric greedy rotated-BEV-IoU matching at IoU 0.5 (the mAOE threshold); heading error folded to [0, pi]
selection.ranking: #cars >= 20 m matched by A and D with A error < 15 deg and D error > 90 deg, minus the reverse; >= 1000 frames apart within a town
